run_xlm_language_transfer_training: run the XLM language transfer training pipeline with multi-GPU distributed support
build_xlm_transformer_model: build an XLM Transformer model with configurable encoder-only or encoder-decoder architecture
create_xlm_training_parser: create an argparse parser for XLM language transfer training with model, data, and optimization flags
test_xlm_model_evaluation: test the XLM model by running all evaluation metrics including perplexity and BLEU scores
refactor_xlm_multi_task_training: refactor the XLM training loop to support multi-task learning with MLM, CLM, MT, AE, BT, and PC steps
